example.en: In keeping with company tradition, the annual bonus announcements were made before the holidays.
example.zh: 依照公司的優良優勢傳統慣例，年終獎金的名額公布均在假期來臨前底定發布。

words.mnemonic: tra- (跨越、交付) + dit (給予) + -ion ＝ 代代相傳之事 ＝ 傳統慣例。

example.en: Retail customers who pay in cash are eligible for an immediate five percent store discount.
example.zh: 使用現金付款的零售門市顧客，即可享有立折百分之五的即時門市優惠。

words.mnemonic: 多益財務高頻：cash flow (現金流)、cash on delivery (貨到付款 COD)。

example.en: There was hardly any difference between the two competing supplier bids in terms of price.
example.zh: 在價格報價方面，這兩家競標供應商的競標條件之間幾乎沒有任何顯著差異。

words.mnemonic: 否定副詞，多益倒裝句或文法考點：hardly any (幾乎沒有任何...)。

example.en: The municipal authority officially awarded the subway construction contract to our firm.
example.zh: 市政府主管當局已正式將該項地鐵工程興建合約授予頒標給我們公司。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重核心義：award ceremony (頒獎典禮) 或 award a contract (授予合約)。

example.en: Corporate travel policies require all non-executive personnel to book flight coach class.
example.zh: 企業差旅報銷政策規定，所有非高階主管同仁出差均必須預訂機票經濟艙。

words.mnemonic: 機票艙等必考：coach class (經濟艙)；人資 executive coach (企業高階主管教練)。

example.en: The advertising team will experiment with personalized mobile app marketing notifications.
example.zh: 廣告行銷團隊將嘗試採用個人化手機應用程式推播通知進行行銷試驗。

words.mnemonic: ex- (出) + peri (嘗試、經歷) + -ment ＝ 實地嘗試 ＝ 實驗、嘗試新策略。

example.en: Environmental impact sustainability was a primary consideration during factory site selection.
example.zh: 在工廠新廠址選址過程中，環境影響與永續性是一項最首要的考量因素。

words.mnemonic: 片語：take into consideration (將...納入考慮)；under consideration (正在研議中)。

example.en: The plant operator halted the conveyor belt after noticing a strange clicking sound.
example.zh: 廠區作業員在注意到輸送帶發出異常的喀噠異音之後，立即將其緊急停機。

words.mnemonic: 設備異常回報常見：strange noise (異常噪音)、strange smell (異常氣味)。

example.en: All employees must review and sign the corporate ethical code of conduct annually.
example.zh: 全體同仁每年均必須仔細研讀並簽名同意遵守企業商業道德行為守則。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：code of conduct (行為守則) 或 promo code (促銷優惠代碼)。

meaning: 無論如何(用於加強語氣)

example.en: We will deliver the replacement equipment parts as quickly as humanly and possibly can.
example.zh: 我們將在人力所能及的前提下，以最快的速度將替換設備零件送達。

words.mnemonic: possible (可能的) + -ly (副詞尾)；as soon as possibly can。

example.en: Phishing emails and ransomware pose a severe cybersecurity threat to corporate financial databases.
example.zh: 網路釣魚信件與勒索軟體對企業金融資料庫構成了嚴峻的網路資安威脅。

words.mnemonic: 資安與商務競爭必備：cyber threat (資安威脅)、pose a threat to (對...構成威脅)。

example.en: The manufacturing plant celebrated one thousand consecutive work days without a lost-time accident.
example.zh: 該製造廠隆重慶祝了創下連續一千個工作天無人員工時損失之工安事故紀錄。

words.mnemonic: 工安常用搭配：workplace accident (職場工安意外)、by accident (偶然、意外地)。

example.en: Without additional temporary staff, completing the audit by Friday will be nearly impossible.
example.zh: 如果沒有額外增派臨時支援人力，要在本週五前完成這項審計作業將幾乎是不可能的。

words.mnemonic: im- (不) + possible (可能的) ＝ 辦不到的 (nearly impossible)。

example.en: Automated cloud enterprise software enables global distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly in real time.
example.zh: 自動化雲端企業軟體使全球各地的分散式團隊能夠即時流暢地進行協同合作。

words.mnemonic: en- (使...) + able (能夠) ＝ 使之具備能力 ＝ enable someone to do。

example.en: I am afraid that today's express courier pickup cutoff time has already passed.
example.zh: 恐怕今天的快遞專件截單收件時間已經截止過去了。

words.mnemonic: 客服禮貌委婉告知壞消息極高頻句型：I am afraid that... (我恐怕.../很抱歉...)。

example.en: Our mobile application has surpassed ten million monthly active consumer users.
example.zh: 我們的手機應用程式每月活躍消費者用戶數已正式突破一千萬大關。

words.mnemonic: 網路行銷與人資考核核心指標：active users (活躍用戶)、take an active role (積極參與)。

example.en: Representatives from both multinational corporations hope to conclude negotiations by tomorrow afternoon.
example.zh: 兩家跨國企業的商務協商代表均期盼能在明天下午前順利圓滿締結談判合約。

words.mnemonic: con- (完全) + clud (關閉) ＝ 完全收尾定案 ＝ 締結合約 (conclude an agreement)。

example.en: The corporate catering menu accommodates specific dietary preferences based on medical or religious reasons.
example.zh: 企業宴會餐飲菜單可充分配合基於醫療考量或宗教信仰的特定飲食偏好需求。

words.mnemonic: 飯店款待與餐飲需求必考情境：religious reasons (宗教因素飲食習慣)。

example.en: The executive employee healthcare plan covers comprehensive annual preventative cancer screenings.
example.zh: 這套高階員工醫療照護保障計畫涵蓋了每年一次的全方位預防性癌症篩檢檢查。

words.mnemonic: 員工健檢福利考點：cancer screening (癌症篩檢)、cancer treatment。

example.en: The sales director presented compelling market data to convince clients of our product reliability.
example.zh: 業務總監提出了極具說服力的市場數據，以使客戶完全信服我們產品的卓越可靠度。

words.mnemonic: con- (完全) + vinc (征服、戰勝) ＝ 在心理上徹底折服對方 ＝ 說服 (convince of)。

example.en: Freight delivery transit delivery times may vary significantly depending on international customs clearance.
example.zh: 貨運運送所需的抵達時間可能會因各國海關清關速度不同而有大幅差異。

words.mnemonic: 多益產品與服務條款極核心句型：vary depending on (隨...而有所變動)。

example.en: Our modern factory plant complies strictly with international ISO environmental safety standards.
example.zh: 我們的新式廠房完全嚴格遵守國際 ISO 環境保護安全認證標準。

words.mnemonic: ESG 與企業責任核心：environmental protection (環境保護)、environmental impact。

example.en: The corporate headquarters installed rooftop solar panels to harness energy from the sun.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓屋頂加裝了太陽能板，以充分汲取來自太陽光的再生能源。

words.mnemonic: 綠能發電常考：solar power (太陽能發電)；sun deck (日照甲板/泳池露台)。

example.en: Despite global inflation pressures, our enterprise maintains a very healthy financial balance sheet.
example.zh: 儘管面臨全球通膨壓力，我們企業依然維持著非常健全穩健的財務資產負債表。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：healthy lifestyle (健康生活) 或 healthy profit (健全豐厚的利潤)。

example.en: The unexpected cancellation of the municipal contract dealt a severe financial blow to the builder.
example.zh: 市政合約的意外遭到取消，對該工程建商造成了極其沉重的財務打擊。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業財經常見搭配：deal a severe blow to (對...造成嚴重沉重打擊)。

example.en: The technology venture plans to invest twenty million dollars into artificial intelligence software research.
example.zh: 該科技創投公司計劃挹注投資兩千萬美元於人工智慧軟體的研發上。

words.mnemonic: in- (進入) + vest (穿上衣服、賦予職務) ＝ 資金投入進去 ＝ invest in (投資於)。

example.en: Passengers holding valid boarding passes should proceed immediately to gate forty-five.
example.zh: 持有有效登機證的旅客請立即前往四十五號登機門候機。

words.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + ceed (走) ＝ 向前行進 ＝ proceed with (繼續辦理)；proceeds (活動收益款)。

example.en: Hotel housekeeping staff wash all bed linens and bath towels using high-temperature sanitation cycles.
example.zh: 飯店房務人員使用高溫消毒程序清洗所有床單被套與浴巾。

words.mnemonic: 房務與清潔規定：wash and iron (洗熨服務)、car wash (洗車)。

example.en: Our marketing advertising firm hired an acclaimed television actor for the commercial campaign.
example.zh: 我們的廣告行銷公司聘請了一位備受讚譽的電視演員來為這場宣傳活動代言拍攝。

words.mnemonic: act (行動、表演) + -or (人) ＝ 廣告演員 (commercial actor)。

example.en: We are glad to inform you that your application for commercial credit financing has been approved.
example.zh: 我們非常高興且榮幸地通知您，您所申請的商業信用融資案已獲正式核准。

words.mnemonic: 商務書信常見禮貌開頭句型：We are glad to inform you that... (我們很高興通知您...)。

example.en: Warehouse dispatch staff use heavy-duty packaging tape to seal outbound cargo boxes securely.
example.zh: 倉儲出貨人員使用高強度的包裝專用膠帶將出境貨物紙箱妥善封緊。

words.mnemonic: 辦公耗材與物流包裝：packaging tape (包裝膠帶)、tape measure (捲尺)。

meaning: 鑒於(法律合約開頭前言)

example.en: Sales in North America increased by eight percent, whereas European branch revenues remained flat.
example.zh: 北美市場的銷售額成長了百分之八，反之歐洲分公司的營收則維持持平。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀與合約必考對比連接詞：whereas = while (然而、反之)。

example.en: Our customer support agents are always ready to assist users with technical software issues.
example.zh: 我們的客戶支援專員隨時準備好協助使用者解決軟體技術問題。

words.mnemonic: 企業承諾常見頻率副詞，表示持續不變的優質服務態度。

example.en: Securing this overseas government contract was a big milestone for our growing business.
example.zh: 拿下這筆海外政府合約是我們成長中企業的一個重大里程碑。

words.mnemonic: 形容商機或規模常用：big opportunity (大好良機)。

example.en: The committee agreed to set a firm deadline for the submission of all design bids.
example.zh: 委員會同意為所有設計競標文件的繳交設定嚴格的最後期限。

words.mnemonic: 極高頻職場片語：set a deadline (設定截止日期)、set up (架設/創立)。

example.en: The government launched an initiative to provide low-interest loans to small businesses.
example.zh: 政府推出了一項向小型企業提供低利貸款的輔導方案。

words.mnemonic: 商業分類常見名詞：small business (中小型企業)。

example.en: A recent market study shows that consumers prefer eco-friendly packaging for cosmetics.
example.zh: 最近一項市場研究顯示，消費者偏好化妝品採用環保包裝。

words.mnemonic: 多益報告常客：market study (市場研究)、conduct a study (進行研究)。

example.en: All factory operators must strictly follow the safety instructions displayed on the bulletin board.
example.zh: 所有工廠操作人員皆必須嚴格遵守公告欄上所張貼的安全守則。

words.mnemonic: 守規矩必備動詞：follow the guidelines / follow the rules (遵守規範)。

example.en: The keynote presentation is scheduled to begin promptly at nine o'clock in the morning.
example.zh: 主旨演講預定於上午九點整準時開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議活動開場動詞：begin promptly at (在...準時開始)。

example.en: The vice president will announce an important policy change during today's press conference.
example.zh: 副總裁將在今日的記者會上宣布一項重大的政策變動。

words.mnemonic: 重要性說明標準詞：play an important role in (扮演要角)。

example.en: Human resources managers strive to cultivate a transparent culture free of toxic office politics.
example.zh: 人力資源經理致力於營造遠離惡性辦公室政治的透明企業文化。

reviewWords.mnemonic: polit- (城市、公民) ＝ 政治運作；office politics (辦公室政治人事角力)。

example.en: Our support center guarantees that agents will reply to client inquiries within two hours.
example.zh: 我們的客服中心保證客服專員會在兩小時之內回覆客戶諮詢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + ply (折疊、回應) ＝ 回覆信函 (reply to an email)。

example.en: New retail tablet models will be prominently displayed on the front showroom floor.
example.zh: 新款零售平板電腦樣機將醒目地展示陳列在前側展廳展示區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: dis- (分開、向外) + play (展開、折疊) ＝ 展開供眾人觀看 ＝ 陳列、展示。

example.en: Her bilingual fluency and international marketing experience make her a perfect candidate for the post.
example.zh: 她的雙語流利程度與跨國行銷歷練使她成為該職位的最佳完美人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: per- (澈底) + fect (做) ＝ 澈底做完做到極致 ＝ 完美的。

example.en: Quarterly operational operating expenditures were slightly lower than preliminary financial projections.
example.zh: 第三季營業營運支出略低於原先初期的財務預算預測。

reviewWords.mnemonic: slight (輕微的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 稍微 (slightly higher / lower than)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial audit demonstrated a noticeable improvement in overall enterprise profitability.
example.zh: 企業年度財務查核報告顯示整體企業獲利能力呈現顯著改善。

reviewWords.mnemonic: over (涵蓋全部) + all (全部) ＝ 全面的、總體的 (overall performance)。

example.en: The pharmaceutical company intends to open three new medical research labs in Singapore.
example.zh: 這間製藥公司打算在新加坡設立三座新的醫藥研發實驗室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: in- (向內) + tend (伸展、傾向) ＝ 心之所向 ＝ 打算做某事 (intend to do)。

example.en: Software engineers conducted usability testing sessions with more than two hundred active users.
example.zh: 軟體工程師與兩百多位活躍用戶共同進行了軟體易用性測試會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: use (使用) + -er (人) ＝ 軟體或產品的使用者 (user manual / experience)。

example.en: Customer service agents are required to respond to urgent complaints within one business day.
example.zh: 客服專員被要求必須在一個工作天內回應緊急客訴問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + spond (承諾、回答) ＝ 給予承諾回覆 ＝ 回應 (respond to)。

example.en: The annual corporate recognition award dinner will be hosted in the hotel grand ballroom.
example.zh: 年度企業優秀員工表揚晚宴將在飯店的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交必備：annual dinner (年終晚宴)、business dinner (商務晚宴)。

example.en: Retail commerce historically experiences a slow sales turnaround period during early February.
example.zh: 零售商業在歷史數據上往往於二月上旬經歷一段較為遲緩的銷售淡季。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 景氣或淡季常用：slow season (淡季)、slow down (減速)。

example.en: Conducting regular preventative maintenance extends the operating lifespan of factory machinery.
example.zh: 進行定期的預防性維護檢修可有效延長廠區機械設備的使用壽命。

reviewWords.mnemonic: regul- (規則) + -ar ＝ 照規則定期的 ＝ 常規的 (regular meeting)。

example.en: The retail book company maintains physical storefronts alongside a booming e-commerce platform.
example.zh: 這家連鎖書商在蓬勃發展電子商務平台的同時，依然維持著實體門市營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: physic (自然、身體) + -al ＝ 實體的 (physical store) 或健檢 (physical exam)。

example.en: Apart from minor cosmetic packaging flaws, all shipments fulfilled strict quality standards.
example.zh: 除了少數包裝上的輕微外觀瑕疵外，全數出貨均符合嚴格的品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: a- + part (部分) ＝ 各自成一部分；片語 apart from (除了...之外)。

example.en: Flexible hybrid remote hours suit the productivity needs of our digital design team.
example.zh: 彈性的混合遠距上班工時極為適合我們數位設計團隊的產能需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場服儀：business suit (商務西裝套裝)；動詞指合適 (suit one's needs)。

example.en: All domestic corporate financial statements must strictly comply with federal tax laws.
example.zh: 所有國內企業的財務報表均必須嚴格遵守聯邦稅法規定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聯邦規範與稅務：federal tax (聯邦稅)、federal regulation (聯邦法規)。

example.en: The internal corporate financial audit revealed several opportunities for cost optimization.
example.zh: 企業內部財務查核結果顯示了數個可供成本優化的絕佳機會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (反、回) + veal (面紗) ＝ 掀開面紗 ＝ 揭曉、揭露。

example.en: A significant percentage of quarterly corporate revenue is reinvested in research initiatives.
example.zh: 企業季度營收中有相當高的百分比被重新投入於研發計畫中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: percent (百分之...) + -age (名詞總稱) ＝ 百分比率。

example.en: Our comprehensive equipment warranty gives corporate clients complete peace of mind.
example.zh: 我們全面的設備保固服務為企業客戶帶來完全的安心保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷與保固文案極常見搭配：peace of mind (安心、無後顧之憂)。

example.en: Customers can track the real-time delivery status of their shipments through our portal.
example.zh: 客戶可透過我們的入口網站即時追蹤其貨物的運送處理狀態。

reviewWords.mnemonic: stat- (站立、處於) ＝ 事情目前所處的狀況 ＝ 進度狀態 (project status)。

example.en: The bank invested millions into cutting-edge cybersecurity to combat financial cybercrime.
example.zh: 該銀行斥資數百萬美元建置先進網路資安系統，以打擊金融科技犯罪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資安防護與法規考點：cybercrime (網路犯罪)、fight crime。

example.en: The regional sales manager had to decline the invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
example.zh: 該區域業務經理因行程衝突而不得不婉拒該項邀請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: de- (向下) + clin (傾斜) ＝ 向下傾斜 ＝ 下降；禮貌婉拒邀請 (decline an offer)。

example.en: Over the past decade, our automotive manufacturing company has doubled its export volume.
example.zh: 在過去十年間，我們的汽車製造公司的出口貿易量已實現翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: dec- (十) + -ade (名詞) ＝ 十年期間 (over the past decade)。

example.en: The technology startup plans to launch its flagship smartphone application next month.
example.zh: 這家科技新創公司計劃於下個月正式推出其旗艦智慧型手機應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 產品上市行銷核心詞：launch a product (發表產品)、product launch (產品發表會)。

example.en: Safety signs prominently warn plant technicians to wear protective eyewear at all times.
example.zh: 安全警示標誌醒目地提醒廠區技術人員必須隨時配戴護目鏡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞 warning (警報/警告通知)；warn someone about/of (提醒某人某事)。

example.en: Extensive consumer behavior market surveys helped guide the design of our new packaging.
example.zh: 廣泛的消費者行為市場調查引導了我們新包裝的設計方向。

reviewWords.mnemonic: consume (消費、消耗) + -er (人) ＝ 消費者 (consumer confidence / goods)。

example.en: A clear majority of board members voted in favor of the international joint venture.
example.zh: 大多數董事會成員投票贊成這項跨國合資合作案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務表決極高頻片語：in favor of (贊成、支持)；ask a favor (請求協助)。

example.zh: 分行辦公室重新整修的總預算支出估計大約在八萬美元上下。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 數額約計片語：somewhere around / between (大約在...左右)。

example.en: The retail chain plans to expand its presence by opening twenty new franchise outlets.
example.zh: 該連鎖零售集團計劃透過開設二十家全新加盟門市來拓展其市場版圖。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + pand (展開) ＝ 向外鋪展開來 ＝ 業務擴張 (expand business/presence)。

example.en: The board resolved to commit substantial financial resources to clean energy development.
example.zh: 董事會決議投入巨額資金財務資源以支持潔淨能源的技術研發。

reviewWords.mnemonic: com- (共同) + mit (送出、託付) ＝ 全力託付承諾 ＝ commit to (致力於)。

example.en: It is obvious that investing in employee training yields superior long-term productivity.
example.zh: 顯而易見的是，投資於員工培訓進修能帶來卓越亮眼的長期生產力回報。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (在前方) + vi (道路) + -ous ＝ 擺在路正前方的 ＝ 顯而易見的。

example.en: Retail sales revenue jumped by twenty percent following the launch of the promotional campaign.
example.zh: 促銷活動正式推行發表之後，零售銷售營收暴漲攀升了百分之二十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財經圖表常見動詞：sales jumped (銷售跳躍式激增)。

meaning: 秘密武器(行銷/競爭手段)

example.en: Advanced data analytics is our firm's most potent competitive weapon in digital marketing.
example.zh: 先進的巨量數據分析是我們公司在數位行銷競爭中最有力的利器秘密武器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭引申義：competitive weapon (市場競爭利器)。

example.en: Our new cloud-based software subscription remains relatively inexpensive compared to rivals.
example.zh: 與同業競爭對手相較，我們這套新型雲端軟體訂閱方案依然維持相對便宜實惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: relative (相對的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 相較之下 (relatively inexpensive)。

example.en: Our downtown corporate convention hotel will host the upcoming international trade summit.
example.zh: 我們位於市中心的商務會議大飯店將主辦即將到來的國際貿易高峰會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務會展必備核心動詞：host an event / conference (主辦活動/大會)。

example.en: The alpine ski resort experiences its peak tourism booking occupancy during the winter season.
example.zh: 這間高山滑雪度假村在冬季期間迎來了其全年度旅遊預訂住房率的最高峰。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 排程與季報考點：winter recess (寒假休假)、winter season (冬季旅遊季)。

example.en: Our international consulting headquarters is strategically situated in the central financial district.
example.zh: 我們的跨國管理顧問總部策略性地座落於市中心的中央金融商務特區。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商辦地段描述核心：financial district (金融特區)、business district (商務特區)。
roots: string- / strict- 拉緊、限制區域

example.en: Our expanded product portfolio appeals to a broad range of international retail customers.
example.zh: 我們擴大推出的產品系列組合能吸引廣泛多元的國際零售消費者群體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業極常見搭配：broad range of (廣泛的...)、broad appeal (廣泛的吸引力)。

example.en: Corporate logistics delivery fleet vehicles undergo mandatory monthly tire pressure inspections.
example.zh: 企業物流運送車隊的所有車輛均必須接受每月定期的強制性胎壓安全檢驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 車隊保養與物流必備：tire pressure (胎壓)、spare tire (備胎)。

example.en: Our fashion retail brand will unveil its new spring clothing collection at next week's expo.
example.zh: 我們的時尚服飾品牌將在下週的博覽會上正式發表其全新春季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 季節促銷常見：spring collection (春季系列)、spring break (春假特惠)。

example.en: The corporate employee retreat successfully fostered a cooperative team spirit among departments.
example.zh: 這場企業員工共識營成功促進了各部門之間通力合作的團隊合作精神。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核特質：team spirit (團隊精神)；in the spirit of (秉持著...的宗旨精神)。

example.en: A complimentary buffet lunch will be provided to all registered trade conference attendees.
example.zh: 所有完成大會報到的商務代表均將獲招待享用免費的精緻自助午餐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議日程表必見項目：lunch break (午餐休息)、business lunch (商務午餐)。

example.en: Actual project production expenditures closely matched our initial preliminary quarterly budget.
example.zh: 專案實際的生產支出花費與我們原先初步編列的季度預算十分高度吻合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務對比極高頻：actual vs projected (實際數值對照預估數值)。

example.en: Our international recruitment drive attracted an exceptionally talented applicant pool.
example.zh: 我們的跨國人才招募活動吸引了素質極其優異頂尖的龐大求職人才庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：applicant pool / talent pool (應徵人才庫) 或 carpool (共乘制度)。

example.en: Streaming platforms are engaged in a fierce market battle for exclusive digital sports rights.
example.zh: 各大線上影音串流平台正展開激烈的市場商戰，爭奪體育賽事的獨家數位轉播權。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭比喻：legal battle (訴訟大戰)、market battle (市佔率爭奪戰)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you again for your patience.
example.zh: 我們對造成的不便深表歉意，並再次感謝您的耐心配合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服道歉信結尾高頻句：Thank you once again (再次感謝您)。

example.en: What kind of warranty coverage is provided with the commercial laser printer?
example.zh: 這款商用雷射印表機隨附何種保固保障？

reviewWords.mnemonic: 詢問規格常用：what kind of (哪一種)；形容詞 kind assistance (親切協助)。

example.en: Please keep your original purchase receipts for at least thirty days to facilitate warranty claims.
example.zh: 請妥善保留原始購買收據至少三十天，以便辦理保固理賠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務溝通片語：keep in mind (牢記在心)、keep updated (隨時保持最新資訊)。

example.en: We were very pleased to hear that your company was awarded the regional trade contract.
example.zh: 我們非常高興得知貴公司榮獲該區域貿易合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交致賀常客：hear from someone (收到某人來信/消息)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters upgraded its internal payroll system to automate tax calculations.
example.zh: 企業總部升級了內部薪資核算系統，以實現稅額自動計算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: IT與辦公科技核心詞：computer system (電腦系統)、operating system (作業系統)。

example.en: Safety inspectors conduct thorough maintenance checks on factory elevators every six months.
example.zh: 安全檢查員每六個月對工廠電梯進行一次全面的維護檢查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率周期考點：every year (每年)、every six months (每六個月)。

example.en: The seminar presenter will answer audience questions during the final twenty minutes of the session.
example.zh: 研討會主講人將在會議最後二十分鐘回答現場觀眾的提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議問答標準詞：question and answer (Q&A 問答環節)。

example.en: Employees may purchase discounted meals in the company cafeteria during lunch hours.
example.zh: 員工可以在午休時間於公司員工餐廳購買優惠餐點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益介系詞大考點：during 後接表示期間的名詞 (如 during the meeting)。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
example.zh: 這間大宴會廳最多可容納兩百位賓客同時入座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想像房間把客人安排進去。

example.en: Please make sure the report is accurate.
example.zh: 編制財務報表時務必提供精準無誤的數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: accurate = correct。

example.en: I have a dentist appointment at three.
example.zh: 請於抵達診所前先以電話完成看診預約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 make 或 confirm 搭配。

example.en: The manager is available after lunch.
example.zh: 會議室目前空著可使用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: available = ready to be used。

example.en: Employees receive health benefits.
example.zh: 新政策為全體員工帶來好處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想成工作帶來的好處。

example.en: Please confirm your reservation by email.
example.zh: 請致電飯店以確認您的訂房資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: confirm = make sure。

example.en: The store is convenient for commuters.
example.zh: 線上預辦登機服務為商務差旅客戶提供了極大便利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 和 convenience 都與方便有關。
roots: ven 來 → 湊在一起正好

example.en: Contact the sales department for details.
example.zh: 行銷部門位在三樓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司裡分工的部門。

example.en: Customers receive a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 凡大量訂購辦公文具者均可享有批量折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 讓價格往下掉。

example.en: Please attach the document to your email.
example.zh: 請於簽署前仔細閱讀文件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文件可以被 attach。
roots: -ument 名詞 → 用來教導／佐證的文件

example.en: The new policy is effective immediately.
example.zh: 新的考勤規範將於下個月初正式生效。

reviewWords.mnemonic: effective = works well。

example.en: The office purchased new equipment.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了最先進的檢驗設備。

reviewWords.mnemonic: equipment 通常不可數。

example.en: The repair estimate is two hundred dollars.
example.zh: 承包商提供了一份詳細的翻修費用估價單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 尚未確定的數字。

example.en: Travel expenses will be reimbursed.
example.zh: 出差員工請在差旅結束後檢據申請差旅費核銷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 pay 或 cost 一起出現。
roots: pens 秤、花費 → 付出去

example.en: The sports facility opens at six.
example.zh: 工廠設施配備了最先進的安全系統。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 提供服務的場所。

example.en: The train runs frequently during rush hour.
example.zh: 這列機場接駁專車尖峰時段每十分鐘密集發車。

reviewWords.mnemonic: frequent 的副詞形式。

example.en: She handles customer complaints professionally.
example.zh: 客服團隊妥善處理了所有客訴案件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: handle a problem = 處理問題。

example.en: Please reply immediately.
example.zh: 收到客訴信函後請立即回覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: immediately = right away。

example.en: The company plans to improve service quality.
example.zh: 我們希望提升客戶滿意度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常接能力或品質。

example.en: Sales increased by fifteen percent.
example.zh: 銷售額增長了百分之十五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可以是名詞或動詞。

example.en: We will inform you of the decision.
example.zh: 我們遺憾地通知您班機將延誤啟程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: inform someone of something。
roots: form 形成 → 使心中成形、告知

example.en: The label lists every ingredient.
example.zh: 這家餐廳堅持只選用新鮮在地的有機食材烹調料理。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 食品標籤常見單字。

example.en: The elevator is closed for maintenance.
example.zh: 本週末因進行空調系統例行維護，辦公大樓將暫停開放。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 building 或 equipment 搭配。

example.en: Ask the manager for assistance.
example.zh: 專案經理審核了時程表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 管理 team 或 department。

example.en: This method saves time and money.
example.zh: 這是一種更有效率的付款方式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: method = way of doing something。

example.en: Did you notice the change in schedule?
example.zh: 請注意這項即將發生的變更。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可表示注意到或公告。

example.en: Applicants must obtain a permit.
example.zh: 進口外國設備前必須先向相關主管機關取得核准執照。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 get 更正式。

example.en: Only trained staff may operate the machine.
example.zh: 只有受過訓練的技術員才能操作這台機器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: operate a machine or company。

example.en: You need permission to enter this area.
example.zh: 員工進入伺服器機房前必須取得主管的正式許可。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 ask for 搭配。

example.en: Please prepare the materials before the meeting.
example.zh: 她為會議準備了簡報資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: prepare for + 事件。

example.en: The company launched a new product.
example.zh: 公司推出了一項新產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常出現在 sales 或 marketing。

example.en: The hotel provides free breakfast.
example.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: provide someone with something。
roots: vid 看 → 事先看顧、供應

example.en: The department purchased new computers.
example.zh: 請保留收據作為這筆購買的證明。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 buy 正式。

example.en: I recommend this restaurant to visitors.
example.zh: 我強烈推薦這款軟體以提高工作效率。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 後面接名詞或動名詞。

example.en: We received a request for more information.
example.zh: 我們收到了客戶提出的退款申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 正式信件常見。

example.en: The position requires two years of experience.
example.zh: 該職位需要兩年工作經驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 need 正式。
roots: quir 尋求 → 一再要求

example.en: The meeting is scheduled for Monday.
example.zh: 新專案的時程表已發送給所有相關主管。

reviewWords.mnemonic: schedule for + 日期。

example.en: The shipment arrived this morning.
example.zh: 新一批零件貨物預計將於本週四清關完成並送達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 和 delivery 有關。

example.en: This is a temporary position.
example.zh: 我們在購物旺季僱用了十位臨時工作人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 相反是 permanent。
reviewWords.roots: tempor 時間 + -ary 形容詞 → 暫時的

example.en: The company posted a vacancy online.
example.zh: 人事部門已在官方徵才網站刊登資深會計主管的職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職缺廣告常用。
